title: bapm Agent Plugins v1 compatibility
boundary: This is bapm's portable Agent Plugins v1 support matrix, not an Agent Plugins certification or universal client-conformance claim.

components.summary: Canonical root plugin.json is validated and can be produced.
Immediate skills/<name>/ directories with SKILL.md are discovered and copied as complete safe directories.
Root mcp.json supports stdio, streamable HTTP, and SSE after portable validation.
Escaping skill paths and reserved or secret-like MCP environment entries are withheld.
Cursor maps portable stdio to stdio, streamable-http to http, and SSE to sse in .cursor/mcp.json.
Hooks, agents, commands, client extensions, OAuth/secrets, sandboxing, and vendor-specific extension behavior are not implemented.
